kev_metadata.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Active Directory contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it distributes passwords that are configured using Group Policy preferences. An authenticated attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could decrypt the passwords and use them to elevate privileges on the domain.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Group Policy Preferences Password Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

title: Microsoft Windows Group Policy Preferences Password Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Apple macOS, iOS, tvOS, Safari, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability in JavaScriptCore that when processing web content may lead to arbitrary code execution. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
